name: Boiler economizer (feedwater heat recovery)
description: Heat exchanger that raises feedwater temperature using flue gas leaving the boiler or superheater, cutting fuel use. Spirax Sarco gives about a 2% efficiency gain per 10 C rise in feedwater temperature; condensing economisers cool gas below the dew point and need corrosion-resistant surfaces.

specifications.metric: efficiency improvement per feedwater temperature rise
specifications.basis: Spirax Sarco: in broad terms a 10 C increase in feedwater temperature gives about a 2% efficiency improvement
Spirax Sarco: about 1% less fuel required for every 6 C temperature rise in the feedtank
B&W: economiser metal temperature can increase at 30-50 F/h (17-28 C/h) during an offline/air-leakage period
ClearFire-CE AHRI thermal efficiency 96.0% with condensing heat exchanger
US convention: 5 sq ft of heat-transfer surface per boiler horsepower is common after 1900 (10 before)
Product bullet: 'Boilers up to 2,500 HP'; accommodates all boiler design pressures

specifications.value: Two-stage: separate non-condensing stack section and condensing section

specifications.basis: Product Overview: tube core assemblies individually removable; all gas side surfaces 316 stainless steel to eliminate corrosion
specifications.value: 316 stainless steel tube with aluminum fins (Al-Fuse)
Condenses on natural gas only; near-condensing mode on #2 oil

specifications.basis: Economizers catalog listing: 'Boost efficiency 3-5% with the ClearFire Economizer (ECF)'
